name: memorix

friction.note_en: Involved setup. install via global npm install; needs docker compose up, git clone (build from source); configure environment variables, config.json/yaml/toml
friction.note_zh: 配置较重。可通过 global npm install 安装；需要 docker compose up、git clone (build from source)；需配置 environment variables、config.json/yaml/toml

analysis.summary_en: One project memory system for Claude Code, Codex, CodeBuddy Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Grok Build, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Oh-my-Pi, Pi, Kiro, Antigravity, Trae, DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, and any MCP-capable…
highlights: memorix background start / memorix serve-http run the HTTP service for a shared endpoint, dashboard, VPS Docker deployment, or multiple clients.
Gemini CLI: installs the extension package, GEMINI.md context, hooks, and skills.
memorix serve is the stdio MCP bridge used by IDEs and coding agents.
Codex: installs one user-level Memorix plugin with bundled stdio MCP, skills, and lifecycle hooks.
analysis.summary_zh_native: 让 Claude Code、Codex、CodeBuddy Code、Cursor、Windsurf、Copilot、Gemini CLI、OpenCode、Grok Build、OpenClaw、Hermes Agent、Oh-my-Pi、Pi、Kiro、Antigravity、Trae、DeepSeek Harness、WorkBuddy 和任何 MCP Agent 共用同一套项目记忆。
highlights_zh: memorix background start / memorix serve-http 是 HTTP 服务，用于共享端点、Dashboard、VPS Docker 部署或多客户端。
Codex：安装包含 stdio MCP、skills 和生命周期 hooks 的 Memorix 插件包，并写入 AGENTS.md 使用规范。
Windsurf、Kiro、Trae：写入目标支持的 MCP / rules / hooks 文件。
memorix CLI 用于直接操作：setup、记忆搜索/写入、Git Memory、导入导出、Dashboard、编排、诊断和自动化。
